comments.author: @pmvincent
comments.text: Well done, from someone who's over 70, was born & raised there, and still has family there.  Spent my youth riding my bike all over the place with my cousins and no adult supervision because everyone who saw us would let my parents know where we were when they walked into our family store to shop for their groceries.  The family store that was started by my grandMother in 1922 and lives on today.  Spent my youth swimming, dancing hula, hunting and fishing with my father, summers working in the pineapple fields.  No matter how long it's been or where I am today, I always consider myself a Molokai Girl.  This video brings back so, so many memories.  Mahalo!
